functions.name: osgEarth::parseVersion
functions.description: Parses a version string into an osgEarth::Version {major, minor, patch}. Intended to convert a textual version (e.g., "3.7.3") into numeric components for programmatic comparison or display. Details of accepted formats and error handling are not documented in the header; based on the name and signature, it most likely expects a dotted numeric triplet and returns the parsed fields.
requirements: str must be a valid, non-null pointer to a NUL-terminated C string.
The expected input format is likely a dotted numeric version string of the form "<major>.<minor>.<patch>"; acceptance of other formats is unknown.
Behavior on malformed input is unspecified; callers should not assume partial parsing or default values.
Function is pure with respect to global state (no arguments besides the input string); thread-safety and side effects are unknown.

functions.name: osgEarthGetVersion
functions.description: Returns the library version string of osgEarth (e.g., "3.7.3"). Exposed with C linkage for use from C or C++. The returned pointer refers to a string owned by the library.
requirements: The returned pointer should be treated as read-only; do not modify or free it (ownership/lifetime not specified in the header, but typical for C APIs returning const char*).
The string is expected to be NUL-terminated; encoding is unspecified (likely ASCII/UTF-8).
Return value may be null is not documented; callers should be prepared to handle a null pointer defensively since the header does not guarantee non-null.
